{"body":"Moved kbbl's core session layer and HTTP handlers onto the runtime-neutral `AgentRuntime` contract and `RuntimeRegistry`, while implementing the contract in the Claude Code adapter:

- **`core/runtime.ts` & `core/runtime-interface.ts`**: Defined `AgentRuntime`, `RuntimeDescriptor`, `RuntimeRegistry`, `createRuntimeRegistry`, `ResumeRef`, `RuntimeSnapshotContrib`, and related types while preserving `AppRuntime` for backward compatibility.
- **`core/session/session.ts` & `core/session/session-manager.ts`**: Added `runtimeId`/`runtimeSid` tracking, `Session.attachRuntime()`, runtime-backed input/abort handling, adapter-delegated snapshot reconstruction (`reconstructSnapshot`), and runtime session ID observation callbacks (`onRuntimeSessionObserved`, `onRuntimeSessionEnded`, `lookupByCcSid`), removing direct Claude Code model imports from `core/session` and `core/orchestrator`.
- **`core/server/handlers/sessions.ts`, `core/server/app.ts`, & `core/server.ts`**: Threaded `RuntimeRegistry` through server/app/session routes for model validation (`isAllowedModel`), resume reference resolution (`resolveResumeRef`), and `/config` runtime descriptor reporting.
- **`adapters/claude-code/index.ts`**: Implemented `AgentRuntime` (`descriptor`, `spawn`, `terminate`, `events`, `send`, `resolveResumeRef`, `reconstructSnapshot`, `isAllowedModel`) alongside CC session ID registry tracking.
- **Verification**: `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` and `bun test` pass cleanly (61 passing tests across 8 test files).","title":"Move core session layer and handlers onto AgentRuntime and RuntimeRegistry"}

submission.body:
Moved kbbl's core session layer and HTTP handlers onto the runtime-neutral `AgentRuntime` contract and `RuntimeRegistry`, while implementing the contract in the Claude Code adapter:

- **`core/runtime.ts` & `core/runtime-interface.ts`**: Defined `AgentRuntime`, `RuntimeDescriptor`, `RuntimeRegistry`, `createRuntimeRegistry`, `ResumeRef`, `RuntimeSnapshotContrib`, and related types while preserving `AppRuntime` for backward compatibility.
- **`core/session/session.ts` & `core/session/session-manager.ts`**: Added `runtimeId`/`runtimeSid` tracking, `Session.attachRuntime()`, runtime-backed input/abort handling, adapter-delegated snapshot reconstruction (`reconstructSnapshot`), and runtime session ID observation callbacks (`onRuntimeSessionObserved`, `onRuntimeSessionEnded`, `lookupByCcSid`), removing direct Claude Code model imports from `core/session` and `core/orchestrator`.
- **`core/server/handlers/sessions.ts`, `core/server/app.ts`, & `core/server.ts`**: Threaded `RuntimeRegistry` through server/app/session routes for model validation (`isAllowedModel`), resume reference resolution (`resolveResumeRef`), and `/config` runtime descriptor reporting.
- **`adapters/claude-code/index.ts`**: Implemented `AgentRuntime` (`descriptor`, `spawn`, `terminate`, `events`, `send`, `resolveResumeRef`, `reconstructSnapshot`, `isAllowedModel`) alongside CC session ID registry tracking.
- **Verification**: `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` and `bun test` pass cleanly (61 passing tests across 8 test files).
submission.title: Move core session layer and handlers onto AgentRuntime and RuntimeRegistry
